general.desc:
**{brand_name}** is a Discord bot created by **{brand_owner}**.
It lets your community **create and share content** called "**[[Pipis]]**s".
Use it to **grow your server**, **find new servers**, and **have fun** by *collecting **[[Pipis]]**s* and *battling your friends*!
general.about_desc:
An **[[Pipis]]** is some text, an attachment (through file or URL), or both.
When an **[[Pipis]]** is created, it is accessible anywhere **{brand_name}** is available.
If the **[[Pipis]]** was created in a **public server**, it contains an **invite** to where it was made!
general.how_desc:
- To **create an [[Pipis]]**, use `/{command_create}` in a server.
- To **receive** an **[[Pipis]]**, use `/{command_get}`.

create.title: About Creating [[Pipis]]
create.desc:
**Commands**: `/{command_create}`, `/{command_lay}`

Using these commands, you may **create an [[Pipis]]**. The **[[Pipis]]** you create will then be available **anywhere that {brand_name} is**.

**Parameters**:
- `{param_create_text}`: [Optional] Add **text** to the **[[Pipis]]**.
  - It will appear as the description of the Embed.
- `{param_create_file}`: [Optional] Add an **attachment** to the **[[Pipis]]**, as a file.
- `{param_create_link}`: [Optional] Add an **attachment** to the **[[Pipis]]**, as a URL.
  - Useful if you want to use GIF providers such as Klipy.
  - ***Note**: You may not use both `{param_create_file}` and `{param_create_link}` at the same time.*
- `{param_create_secret}`: [Optional] Mark an **[[Pipis]]** as **Secret**!
  - This means that it **won't be possible** to view this **[[Pipis]]** by ID: only randomly!
- `{param_create_rating}`: [Optional] The **content rating** of the **[[Pipis]]**.
  - `{choice_rating_safe}`, `{choice_rating_questionable}`, or `{choice_rating_explicit}`.
    - **More explicit ratings** are only allowed in **NSFW channels**. It depends on the server's settings.

get.title: About Obtaining [[Pipis]]
get.desc:
**Commands**: `/{command_get}`, `/{command_egg}`

Using these commands, you will **receive an [[Pipis]]**. If the `{param_get_id}` parameter isn't specified, the **[[Pipis]]** will be **picked randomly from the global pool** and **added to your collection** if you haven't seen it before.

**Parameters**:
- `{param_get_id}`: [Optional] View a specific **[[Pipis]]** by searching for its ID.

edit.title: About Editing [[Pipis]]
edit.desc:
**Commands**: `/{command_edit}`

Using this command, you may **edit an [[Pipis]]**. You must have permission to manage it: so you must either **be its creator** or **be a Server Manager where it was created**.
You **only override the parameters you select here**, meaning that, if you made a text-only **[[Pipis]]** and wanted to make it Secret, you would only need to set `{param_edit_secret}` to `True` here, without touching `{param_edit_text}`.

**Parameters**:
- `{param_edit_id}`: The ID of the **[[Pipis]]** you want to edit.
- Other parameters are the same as `/{command_create}`/`/{command_lay}`.

report.title: About Reporting [[Pipis]]
report.desc:
**Commands**: `/{command_report}`

Using this command, or through the "Report" button when receiving an **[[Pipis]]**, you can **report an [[Pipis]]**. This will send it to the global **[[Pipis]] Moderators**, who will decide what action to take. If you suspect that an **[[Pipis]]** may be violating a rule, don't hesistate to report it!

**Parameters**:
- `{param_report_id}`: The ID of the **[[Pipis]]** you want to report.

delete.title: About Deleting [[Pipis]]
delete.desc:
**Commands**: `/{command_delete}`

Using this command, you may **delete an [[Pipis]]**. You must have permission to manage it: so you must either **be its creator** or **be a Server Manager where it was created**.

**Parameters**:
- `{param_delete_id}`: The ID of the **[[Pipis]]** you want to delete.

eggify.desc:
You may **turn a message into an [[Pipis]]** by right-clicking it (or holding it, on mobile), going to the *Apps* menu, and choosing ***Eggify***.
From there, you can **modify the text** (by default, it'll be the *original message's content*), set its **Secret** status, and choose its **rating**.

collected.title: About [[Pipis]] Collections
collected.desc:
**Commands**: `/{command_collected}`

Using this command, you can **view your [[Pipis]] collection**, which is comprised of all the **[[Pipis]]**s you found randomly. Alternatively, you may also use the `{param_collected_check}` parameter to see if you have collected a specific **[[Pipis]]**.

**Parameters**:
- `{param_collected_check}`: [Optional] The ID of an **[[Pipis]]**, to see if you've collected it.
- `{param_collected_rating}`: [Optional] Filters your collection by a specific **rating**.
- `{param_collected_secret}`: [Optional] Filters your collection, and shows you only the **Secret [[Pipis]]**s you've found.

leaderboard.desc:
**Commands**: `/{command_leaderboard} {command_leaderboard_collections}`, `/{command_leaderboard} {command_leaderboard_creations}`, `/{command_leaderboard} {command_leaderboard_battles}`, `/{command_leaderboard} {command_leaderboard_battlers}`

The leaderboard commands allow you to view the **Top 15** of a certain category.
These categories are:
- **Collections**: Users who have collected the most **[[Pipis]]**s.
- **Creations**: Users who have created the most **[[Pipis]]**s.
- **Battles**: **[[Pipis]]**s that have won the most battles.
- **Battlers**: Users who have won the most battles.

config.desc:
**Commands**: `/{command_config} {command_lang}`, `/{command_config} {command_allow-ext-lang}`, `/{command_config} {command_privacy}`, `/{command_config} {command_log}`, `/{command_config} {command_allowed-ratings}`, `/{command_config} {command_join-button}`, `/{command_config} {command_battle-time}`, `/{command_config} {command_channel-rating}`

The configuration commands allow Server Managers to set up **{brand_name}** the way they see fit.

- `/{command_config} {command_lang}`: Sets the bot's **response language** in this server (or for a user, if ran in DMs).
  - `{param_lang_language}` parameter: The language to set.
- `/{command_config} {command_allow-ext-lang}`: Permit usage of **user-specified languages** in this server.
  - `{param_allow-ext-lang_allow}` parameter: True or False.
- `/{command_config} {command_privacy}`: Change the **privacy setting** for this server (or for a user, if ran in DMs).
  - `{param_privacy_public}` parameter: True or False.
    - **In servers**: Allow **anyone** to **join this server** through **[[Pipis]]**s created in it.
    - **In DMs**: Allow anyone who **views one of your [[Pipis]]** to see your **username** and **profile**.
- `/{command_config} {command_log}`: Set a **log channel** for **[[Pipis]] creations and edits** that happen in this server.
  - `{param_log_channel}` parameter: The log channel to use.
- `/{command_config} {command_allowed-ratings} {command_allowed-ratings_normal}`: Change which **ratings** are allowed in **SFW channels**.
  - `{param_allowed-ratings_normal_s}`, `{param_allowed-ratings_normal_q}`, `{param_allowed-ratings_normal_e}` parameters: Whether each rating is allowed. Omitted ones keep their current value.
- `/{command_config} {command_allowed-ratings} {command_allowed-ratings_nsfw}`: Change which **ratings** are allowed in **NSFW channels**.
  - `{param_allowed-ratings_nsfw_s}`, `{param_allowed-ratings_nsfw_q}`, `{param_allowed-ratings_nsfw_e}` parameters: Whether each rating is allowed. Omitted ones keep their current value.
- `/{command_config} {command_join-button}`: Change whether the **"Join Origin Server"** button appears on **[[Pipis]]**s gotten here.
  - `{param_join-button_viewable}` parameter: True or False.
- `/{command_config} {command_battle-time}`: Change how **long battles** last before they expire.
  - `{param_battle-time_minutes}` parameter: How many minutes a battle should last.
- `/{command_config} {command_channel-rating}`: Set the **default rating** for **[[Pipis]]**s created in a channel.
  - `{param_channel-rating_channel}` parameter: The channel to set the rating for.
  - `{param_channel-rating_rating}` parameter: The new default rating for that channel.

filter.title: About Filtering [[Pipis]]
filter.desc:
**Commands**: `/{command_filter}`

Using this command, Server Managers can **toggle filtering** for an **[[Pipis]]**. This is helpful when an **[[Pipis]]** does not break the *global* rules, and therefore is allowed by the **[[Pipis]] Moderators**, but *local* server moderators feel it's inappropriate for their members.
If an **[[Pipis]]** was **already filtered**, running this command on it again will **unfilter it**.

**Parameters**:
- `{param_filter_id}`: The ID of the **[[Pipis]]** you want to toggle filters for.

filter.unfiltered:
Successfully **unfiltered** **[[Pipis]] #{egg_id}**.
It can now **appear again** in this server.
filter.filtered:
Successfully **filtered** **[[Pipis]] #{egg_id}**.
It will **no longer appear** in this server.
